justifications.evidence: The record rests on the run's readable gate logs (base and head both green, added_failure_count 0), the reviewed run's own guard-removal negative control (3 failed with DID NOT RAISE, EXIT=1, with measurement_module and cwd named), plus two independent re-runs here: the head route gate (4 passed) and a fresh guard-no-op negative control (3 failed, 1 passed, EXIT=1). The one gap is the head arm of tests/test_fused_same_state_read.py: that file was modified in the commit, but the only run of it (fused-route-base.log) carries a header revision of the base sha a6fe0d05b at 11:53, eight minutes before the 12:01 commit, so a post-commit run of the modified file is not separately evidenced. The modification only changes an exception type on a path the passing tests do not execute, and the modified module is imported and exercised by the head route run, so the risk is low but the head-arm result is inferred.
justifications.fit: The named-outcome pattern (a dict carrying outcome='no_qualified_axis' with the exception class and message) matches the pre-existing catch already present in benchmarks/xpoint_cell_allocation_rca.py and the read catch at settled_mask_stall.py:788, and the tests reuse the existing machine and _with_direct_samples fixtures rather than adding scaffolding. The cell_current_moments read is guarded at the operator boundary where the refusal originates, which is the narrowest correct site.
justifications.goal_fidelity: Every eager reader named by the followup now converts the unqualified-axis refusal into a named outcome, and the three production eager reads that can raise are covered on both a qualified and an unqualified state. The only shortfall from the literal plan text is that the first host is the operator's cell_current_moments (forward_operator.py:3588) that the profile delegates to, not a method named ForwardProfile.cell_current_moments -- a plan-naming imprecision rather than a coverage gap.
justifications.scope_discipline: The commit changes exactly the eight declared write paths and nothing else; no production nova/ module, plan file, or shared state is touched, consistent with the node's 'No change to nova/.' constraint.
